nodes.label: CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT Permission Restriction
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Signature|privileged permission unavailable to third-party apps; blocks VOICE_CALL/VOICE_DOWNLINK/VOICE_UPLINK capture and has no public uplink-injection equivalent, making cellular audio inaccessible to normal Android apps.

nodes.label: PrivilegedCarrierMediaBridge (OEM Extension Point)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Optional extension interface for OEM/priv-app/rooted builds where CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT is available; defaults to unsupported in retail distribution so the app always falls back to the compliant SIP/VoIP engine.

nodes.label: sipAgent / pstnControl Product Flavor Separation
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Splits the app into two flavors to enforce privacy boundaries: sipAgent has INTERNET and full autonomous AI calling; pstnControl has no INTERNET and disables autonomous calling entirely, guaranteeing zero network exfiltration for cellular call screening.

nodes.label: App-Owned SIP/VoIP Media Pipeline
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Chosen because CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT is unobtainable by third-party apps and there is no API to inject synthetic PCM into the cellular uplink; owning SIP/RTP media gives full bidirectional audio ownership needed for local VAD/ASR/TTS and sub-150ms barge-in without special privileges.

nodes.label: BenchmarkRunner (On-Device Performance Test)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Runs during onboarding to empirically gate autonomous calling (composite score >=70/100) rather than relying on nominal RAM/CPU specs alone, since real inference performance varies by device.

nodes.label: Device Qualification Matrix & Hardware Requirements
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.label: DialerValidator (Emergency Number Blocking)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Strictly blocks 3-digit and emergency destinations (911/112/999/988), delegating to the native dialer, to satisfy the legal prohibition on automated agents dialing emergency services.

nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.label: Gemma 4 E2B Language Model
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Selected as primary on-device LLM due to Apache/Gemma-license commercial usability, ~2.58GB LiteRT-LM package size, and strong flagship Android benchmark performance suited to conversational latency targets.

nodes.label: LiteRT-LM Runtime
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.label: LocalEncryptedTranscriptStore (AES-256-GCM)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Encrypts call transcripts/results with AES-256-GCM keyed in AndroidKeyStore/Titan M2 so stored data remains protected even if the device filesystem is inspected after theft.

nodes.label: NetworkPolicyEnforcer
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Restricts sipAgent flavor sockets to only the user-configured SIP registrar host/port, actively blocking any other outbound destination.

nodes.label: PrivacyAudit (Telemetry Key Blocklist)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Rejects telemetry events containing forbidden keys (transcript, audio, pcm, text, prompt, response, phone, card, ssn, user_input) to guarantee no conversational content reaches logs or crash reporters.

nodes.label: Redactor (PII Redaction, Luhn Validation)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Sanitizes credit cards (Luhn-validated), SSNs, phone numbers, and emails before persistence or display to prevent PII leakage even though the pipeline is otherwise fully local.

nodes.label: ConversationController
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.label: SafetyValidator (Deterministic Safety Contract)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Interposed between LLM output and telephony execution; the model has zero access to transactional tools, so any decision attempting a purchase, appointment, or credential disclosure is intercepted and replaced with termination/handoff, mitigating adversarial prompt injection from IVRs/businesses.

nodes.label: STRIDE Threat Analysis Methodology
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits

nodes.label: AgentDecision Structured Output Schema
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Constrains the LLM to emit a validated enum action plus bounded fields rather than free-form commands, so only the deterministic orchestrator can trigger real actions; malformed output triggers a single safe retry then handoff/abort.

nodes.label: CallTransport Interface (supportsProgrammaticMedia)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Central abstraction with a supportsProgrammaticMedia flag; the PSTN implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException on remoteAudio/sendAudio by design, preventing future developers from quietly adding an unsupported cellular-audio hack.

nodes.label: DeviceCapabilities Probe (autonomousCarrierMedia flag)
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: autonomousCarrierMedia is hard-pinned false in all ordinary third-party builds, with tests proving no OEM/Android-version heuristic can silently flip it, preventing the UI from ever advertising unsupported cellular AI autonomy.

nodes.label: Staged MVP Development Order
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Recommends building the SIP client and raw PCM in/out first, before TTS/ASR/Gemma integration, because proving bidirectional PCM injection over SIP resolves the hardest architectural risk; everything after becomes ordinary ML/audio engineering.

nodes.label: VoipClient Interface Abstraction
nodes.community_name: Docs: Legal, Device Support, Cellular Limits
nodes.rationale: Hides the SIP implementation library behind a Kotlin interface exposing only PCM/state flows so the AI conversation code never needs to know about SIP details, allowing the SIP library to be swapped later.
